thread:
maria_ops: quick heads-up — we're seeing a small burst of NIC retransmits on saturn-rack-03 starting ~22:10 UTC, likely related to yesterday's driver rollout. not service-wide yet, but slightly elevated p99 egress latency. :warning:
kevin_infra: saw the spike in net telemetry. looks correlated with kernel module v1.2.4 on cohort 3 nodes. low error rate but growth trend. i'll start slicing metrics by tenant.
sophia_sre: can we do a targeted soft drain for cohort-3 nodes in saturn-rack-03? prefer graceful task handoff, 5m grace, avoid full reboot if possible.
maria_ops: yes please — target window tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC (low traffic). plan: cordon -> soft-drain -> quick nic reset -> uncordon. keep one node spare for canary.
kevin_infra: command i'll run:
```
invctl drain --pool saturn-rack --cohort 3 --grace 300 --mode soft --canary 1
```
kevin_infra: will run pre-checks first, verify kv-cache seeds on backfills and prefix cache warmup.
ops-oncall: noted. i'll page customers tagged as enterprise-dedicated if we hit >5% error budget. also will watch Dedicated pools for spillover.
ryan_product: if this might affect SLAs, loop in cs and legal? we should prepare a short banner in console if latency crosses threshold.
sophia_sre: agree. add a fallback policy to route low-priority requests to eu-west fallback pool during the 30m window.
maria_ops: cost note — routing to fallback increases cross-region egress estimates; expect ~1200 USD/hr if sustained. tag billing watchers.
kevin_infra: preflight checklist: 1) ensure canary node drains cleanly 2) confirm kv cache reseed 3) nic firmware health OK 4) no active long-running batches >10m 5) alerting mute set for noise.
kevin_infra: starting canary drain in 5m and will post results.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: kernel-driver-v1.2.4 -> cohort-3 rollback candidate ready.
sophia_sre: canary passed — small reconnects but tasks migrated fine. proceeding for cohort but will throttle to 1 node / 2min.
maria_ops: doing live comms: posting to #status and sending short note to cs with expected window.
ops-oncall: watching dashboards: p99 egress down after canary. i'll standby for rollback sign-off. :thumbsup:
kevin_infra: finishing cohort 3. last node uncordoned at 23:18 UTC. no customer-facing incidents.
maria_ops: thanks team. follow-up action: schedule a coordinated nic-driver rollback/patch next week with longer preflight and runbook updates. i'll create the runbook PR.
ryan_product: please include a short blurb for product teams on behavior differences for fallbacks.
sophia_sre: Logged postmortem note and added an eval to alert for early retransmit slope.
maria_ops: closing thread — great job. if anyone sees residual anomalies, ping here. :sparkles:
